map.输入终极赔款与已付比例，求 IBNR 准备金。: Enter the ultimate loss and paid ratio to find the IBNR reserve.

map.📚 深度解析：IBNR 估算（终极×未付比例）: 📚 Deep Dive: IBNR Estimation (Ultimate × Unpaid Ratio)
map.由终极赔款乘未付比例估已发生未报案准备金。: Estimate the IBNR reserve as ultimate loss times the unpaid ratio.
map.IBNR = 100000×(1−0.7) = 30000。即尚待发生/未报约: IBNR = 100000×(1−0.7) = 30000. That is, about 30k remains to occur / unreported.
map.已付比例高说明什么？: What does a high paid ratio indicate?
map.已付 70% 说明理赔较成熟，IBNR 仅剩 30%；早期业务已付低 IBNR: Paid 70% means claims are mature, with only 30% IBNR left; early-stage business with low paid has a large IBNR share and high uncertainty.
map.用已付比例估 IBNR 会低估吗？: Does estimating IBNR by paid ratio understate it?
map.会。已付比例高仅代表钱付得快，未报案案件（reporting lag）仍可能大量: Yes. A high paid ratio only means money is paid fast; unreported claims (reporting lag) may still be substantial. A safer approach uses the reported ratio or chain-ladder to estimate both IBNR and reported-unpaid together.
